name: foray-audio
description: Foray's own Capacitor plugin: the mediaPlayback foreground service the Android shell needs to keep backgrounded <audio> alive. NOT published, NOT a third-party dependency — it is this repo's hand-written native code, kept in its own directory so it survives `cap add android` regenerating mobile/android/ and so a reviewer can read the whole of it. See docs/android-native-code.md for why this directory exists rather than a committed mobile/android/.
//no-ios: Deliberately Android-only. docs/research/mp1-background-audio.md §7.3: on iOS WebKit sets the AVAudioSession category itself for an audible <audio> element, so the entire iOS requirement is the UIBackgroundModes key — which tools/mobile/inject-background-audio.mjs already writes. Adding an ios/ src here would be native code with nothing to do.
//no-js-entry: No main/module/types on purpose. The web half of this plugin is web/foray-audio-shell.js, which the app loads as an ordinary same-origin <script type=module> placed by tools/mobile/prepare-webdir.mjs. There is no bundler in this repo (the root is dependency-free with no build step), so the shell talks to native through window.Capacitor.nativePromise() rather than through an imported @capacitor/core proxy.
